expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第10–25天释放时间由约80ms升至约120ms。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 10–25: release time rises from about 80 ms to about 120 ms.

expected_health_response.zh: 10天前 NORMAL；漂移期 WATCH/WARNING；之后 WARNING/CRITICAL。不得推断泄漏率。
expected_health_response.en: NORMAL before day 10; WATCH/WARNING during; WARNING/CRITICAL after. Leakage rate must not be inferred.

abstention_cases.zh: 泄漏率估计必须返回不支持（INELIGIBLE_INPUT）：仅有释放时间。
abstention_cases.en: Leakage-rate estimation must return unsupported (INELIGIBLE_INPUT): only release time is available.

limitations.zh: 释放时间不能单独推断泄漏率。
limitations.en: Release duration alone cannot give a leakage rate.
